68870 Federal Register/Vol. 91, No. 209/Friday, October 30, 2026/Presidential Documents

Annex II

A. Effective with respect to goods entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for
consumption, on or after 12:01 a.m. eastern time on October 30, 2026, subchapter HI of
chapter 99 of the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS) is modified as

follows:

1. Subdivision (b)(3) of U.S. note 51 1s modified by:

a.
